files_after.config.toml:
schema_version = 2

[server]
host = "127.0.0.1"
port = 8765
allow_non_loopback = false
lan = true
lan_networks = []

[llm]
auto_classify = true
auto_embed = true

[llm.providers.ollama]
type = "ollama"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
timeout_seconds = 120.0
max_retries = 2
backoff_seconds = 1.0

[llm.providers.heuristic]
type = "heuristic"

[llm.classification]
provider = "ollama"
model = "qwen2.5:7b-instruct"

[llm.embeddings]
provider = "ollama"
model = "nomic-embed-text"

[llm.summarization]
provider = "ollama"
model = "qwen2.5:7b-instruct"

[agents]

[execution]
enabled = true
default_agent = "claude_code"
max_concurrent_runs = 2
max_attempts_per_task = 3
auto_schedule = false
isolation = "worktree"
allow_push = false
allow_merge = false

[jobs]
worker_concurrency = 4
gpu_concurrency = 1
per_agent_concurrency = 2
per_repository_concurrency = 1
verify_concurrency = 1
lease_seconds = 60
default_max_attempts = 5

[stacks]
auto_accept = true

[verification]
auto_accept = true

[retention]
telemetry_payload_days = 30
run_log_days = 90

[claude]
capture_tool_payloads = false
max_payload_chars = 4000

[automation]
max_depth = 3

[trackers]
